constraints: model seed fixed, temperature=0, no hidden gold in prompt/tool evidence; no external provider API. Graph extraction from pinned previous run backend none; 0 LLM graph tokens. All results Research.
negative_controls: preserve false positives, omitted files, malformed outputs and model errors
outputs: exact set accuracy, macro precision/recall/F1, tool seconds, prompt+completion tokens from model usage, total tokens per task. Record failures, raw outputs and evidence hashes.
regimen: Each arm invokes its fixed retrieval adapter; the SAME local model sees the fixed prompt plus tool evidence once and emits JSON file paths. Stateless model calls and task-order rotation. No model-written code, no autonomous tool choice.
research_status: Research; no independent claims; exploratory pilot
task_selector: Unique definitions, names>=14 and nonprivate, 3..18 AST-call-file hits, exclude tests/vendored definition files. Rank stable SHA256(seed|function|defining path), first 12.
task_spec: Find tracked .py files containing ast.Call of Name(function) or Attribute(...,function). Does not establish binding to a particular definition.
